scope: Non-invasive preparation accounting; no VM or application execution
interval_limit: Begins after initial mandatory reading/Git inspection; includes reasoning, research, coding, command waits and documentation. Final validation/publication continued afterwards. Not human labour time.
engineering_effort: One primary agent; active reasoning time and model billing/tokens not separately measured. No delegated agent or application-driving agent.
pending_human_prerequisite: Owner review/execution of exact Hyper-V membership command, followed by token refresh; no completed action is claimed.
intervention_reporting_for_future_run: Record host permission/token refresh, guest setup, planned GUI assistance and unexpected interventions separately, with actions and attended minutes.
unmetered_reads: Small browser/source queries and one WineHQ Release inspection; no full ISO/runtime package body.
private_size_caveat: Sum of file lengths, not filesystem allocation; includes installer/metadata/scripts/fixture ZIPs/private records. Later receipts add a small amount.
